answer_1.quote: The task of KG-to-text generation has been proposed to make this structured information more accessible to humans, aiming to generate fluent, informative, and faithful natural-language sentences...
answer_1.outputs: Natural language text describing the KG

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to measure both fluency and faithfulness of generated text. Following existing KG-to-text work, we employ standard metrics BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE-L ... we use BARTScore and FactCC for comparing the generated text with the linearized input graph for measuring faithfulness.

answer_3.quote: We propose to utilize ChatGPT to further measure the factual consistency and fluency of the generated text... we prompt ChatGPT to score the fluency of the generated text and to enumerate facts in the input graph and output text to compute precision, recall and hallucination rates.
